criteria.text: Privacy and recovery descriptions match actual key management and documented lost-secret limits.
criteria.reason: Current UI states encrypted recovery/password no-reset, lost key limits, raw key import warning and fresh backup after independently random claim secrets. docs/recovery.md and BUILDING.md describe random keys, full salts, encrypted journal scope, unlocked-page/PXE limitations and explicit key custody.
